💰 FinOps Pricing Model, Free Tier & CUDs

Billing Model: Consumption-Based Pay-As-You-Go
Metered Units: Active resource-hours • API operations • GiB ingested

Key Cost Watchouts:

  • Automated polling frequency on high-scale APIs
